# S15 try positions: `?` in a for post clause and in a switch
# expression init lowers out of the loop and out of the switch IIFE,
# so an error there returns from the enclosing function before the
# next iteration and before any arm. The ejected tree builds under
# plain go with the same behavior.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m

logos run .
cp stdout $WORK/logos-stdout.txt

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
! grep '\?' out/main.go
! grep 'misplaced' out/main.go

cd out
go run .
cp stdout $WORK/eject-stdout.txt
cmp stdout $WORK/eject-stdout.txt
cd ..
cmp $WORK/logos-stdout.txt $WORK/eject-stdout.txt
cmp $WORK/logos-stdout.txt want-stdout.txt

exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/trypos

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
)

var errStep = errors.New("step")

var postCalls int
var bodies int

func next(v int) (int, error) {
	postCalls++
	if v == 2 {
		return 0, errStep
	}
	return v + 1, nil
}

func nextOK(v int) (int, error) {
	postCalls++
	return v + 1, nil
}

func sumOK() (total int, err error) {
	for i := 0; i < 3; i = nextOK(i)? {
		bodies++
		total += i
	}
	return total, nil
}

func sumFail() (total int, err error) {
	for i := 0; i < 5; i = next(i)? {
		bodies++
		total += i
	}
	return total, nil
}

func load(fail bool) (int, error) {
	postCalls++
	if fail {
		return 0, errStep
	}
	return 7, nil
}

func classify(fail bool) (string, error) {
	r := switch n := load(fail)?; n {
	case 7 => "seven"
	default => "other"
	}
	return r, nil
}

func gate(a bool, fail bool) (bool, error) {
	ok := a && (switch n := load(fail)?; n { case 7 => true; default => false })
	return ok, nil
}

func spin() (int, error) {
	c := 0
	for i := 0; (switch k := nextOK(i)?; k { case 3 => false; default => true }); i++ {
		c++
	}
	return c, nil
}

var ord []int

func g() int {
	ord = append(ord, 1)
	return 10
}

func loadOrd(v int) (int, error) {
	ord = append(ord, 2)
	return v, nil
}

func useOrder() (int, error) {
	r := g() + (switch n := loadOrd(7)?; n { case 7 => 1; default => 2 })
	return r, nil
}

func keepScope(v int) (int, error) {
	n := 10
	r := n + (switch n := loadOrd(v)?; n { case 7 => 1; default => 2 })
	_ = r
	return n, nil
}

func nested(v int) (int, error) {
	r := switch 1 { case 1 => switch n := loadOrd(v)?; n { case 7 => 1; default => 2 }; default => 3 }
	return r, nil
}

func viaClosure() (int, error) {
	f := func() (int, error) {
		r := switch n := loadOrd(7)?; n { case 7 => 1; default => 2 }
		return r, nil
	}
	return f()
}

func ifPick(v int) (int, error) {
	if (switch n := loadOrd(v)?; n { case 7 => true; default => false }) {
		return 1, nil
	}
	return 0, nil
}

func main() {
	postRuns()
	initRuns()
	orderRuns()
}

func postRuns() {
	postCalls = 0
	bodies = 0
	total, err := sumOK()
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("post-nil: unexpected error", err)
	} else {
		fmt.Println("post-nil:", err == nil, total, postCalls, bodies)
	}
	postCalls = 0
	bodies = 0
	total, err = sumFail()
	if err == nil {
		fmt.Println("post-err: unexpected success", total)
	} else {
		fmt.Println("post-err:", err == errStep, total, postCalls, bodies)
	}
}

func initRuns() {
	postCalls = 0
	s, err := classify(false)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("init-nil: unexpected error", err)
	} else {
		fmt.Println("init-nil:", err == nil, s, postCalls)
	}
	s, err = classify(true)
	if err == nil {
		fmt.Println("init-err: unexpected success", s)
	} else {
		fmt.Println("init-err:", err == errStep, s == "", postCalls)
	}
	postCalls = 0
	ok, err := gate(false, true)
	fmt.Println("short-false:", err == nil && ok == false, postCalls)
	ok, err = gate(true, false)
	fmt.Println("short-true:", err == nil && ok == true, postCalls)
	postCalls = 0
	c, err := spin()
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("loop-cond: unexpected error", err)
	} else {
		fmt.Println("loop-cond:", err == nil, c, postCalls)
	}
}

func orderRuns() {
	ord = nil
	r, err := useOrder()
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("order: unexpected error", err)
	} else {
		fmt.Println("order:", err == nil, r, ord)
	}
	ord = nil
	n, err := keepScope(7)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("scope: unexpected error", err)
	} else {
		fmt.Println("scope:", err == nil, n, ord)
	}
	ord = nil
	r, err = nested(7)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("nested: unexpected error", err)
	} else {
		fmt.Println("nested:", err == nil, r, ord)
	}
	ord = nil
	r, err = viaClosure()
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("closure: unexpected error", err)
	} else {
		fmt.Println("closure:", err == nil, r, ord)
	}
	ord = nil
	q, err := ifPick(7)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("ifcond: unexpected error", err)
	} else {
		fmt.Println("ifcond:", err == nil, q, ord)
	}
}
-- m/want-stdout.txt --
post-nil: true 3 3 3
post-err: true 0 3 3
init-nil: true seven 1
init-err: true true 2
short-false: true 0
short-true: true 1
loop-cond: true 2 3
order: true 11 [1 2]
scope: true 10 [2]
nested: true 1 [2]
closure: true 1 [2]
ifcond: true 1 [2]
